title: The Faithful Atlas
author: Ivo Kavanagh
blurb: Kestrel Zhou, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
